Didge — installing on Windows
=============================

Copy each format you want into its folder.

  Didge.vst3  ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  Didge.clap  ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\
  Didge.exe   ->  anywhere; it needs no host

Both plug-in folders are outside your user profile, so Windows will ask for
administrator confirmation when you copy into them. If you would rather not
grant that, most hosts can also scan a folder of your own choosing -- add one
in the host's plug-in settings and copy there instead.

Then restart your host so it rescans.


These builds are not signed

SmartScreen will interrupt the first launch of the standalone with "Windows
protected your PC". Choose More info, then Run anyway. That warning is about
the missing signature, not about the contents.


Requirements

  - 64-bit Windows 10 or later.
  - The Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime, which draws the interface. It ships
    with Windows 11 and with current Windows 10. If the plug-in loads but its
    window stays blank, install it from:
    https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/

Building from source avoids the signing warnings, and is four commands. See
README.md.
